source: Athletic.net official results for the four OHSAA regionals on Oct 31, 2026 (Central at Pickerington 287237, Northeast at Boardman 287234, Northwest at Tiffin 287247, Southwest at Troy 287241), compiled by Zachary in dataimports/Ohio_XC_Regionals_2026_All_Results.xlsx; every race re-checked against Athletic.net at 7:00 PM ET. Parsed verbatim, nothing recomputed.
workbookNotes: Troy D1 Boys: Gabe Potts (Wayne) is listed DNF with no place and no time; kept with dnf: true.
Tiffin D4 Boys, 239th: Athletic.net corrected "Max Pursell" (no grade) to "Max Parsell" (11, Mohawk) after the race; the workbook carries the corrected name and no Athletic.net ID.

Team ties were decided by Athletic.net's official team places (sixth-runner tiebreak): Pickerington D1 Girls, Hilliard Davidson and Gahanna Lincoln at 136; Boardman D2 Boys, Shaker Heights and Hoover at 265; Boardman D3 Girls, Marlington and Crestwood at 127.
"Cal. River Valley" is River Valley (Caledonia); "Bid. River Valley" is River Valley (Bidwell).
Perrysburg (Northwest) ran the D1 regional at Boardman; Tiffin had no D1 race.

regional.label: Use only regional results
regional.timeBasis: Each runner's Oct 31, 2026 regional time. Four different courses, not course-adjusted.

bestDistrictRegional.label: Use best from district and regional
bestDistrictRegional.timeBasis: The faster of each runner's Oct 24 district time and Oct 31 regional time (regional time when no district time matches). Different courses, not course-adjusted.

averageDistrictRegional.label: Use average of district and regional
averageDistrictRegional.timeBasis: The average of each runner's Oct 24 district time and Oct 31 regional time. District times matched by exact name and school. Different courses, not course-adjusted.

season.label: Use best from the season
season.timeBasis: Each runner's fastest known 2026 time: the Podium Watch season-best roster, the Oct 24 district time or the Oct 31 regional time, whichever is fastest. Different courses, not course-adjusted.
